points.title: 童年与艺术启蒙
points.description: 萨尔瓦多·达利出生于西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区的菲格拉斯，他的出生地后来成为他最重要的作品之一——达利剧院博物馆的所在地。达利的童年受到严格的天主教教育，同时展现出非凡的艺术天赋。他的哥哥早逝的经历对他产生了深远影响，这种对死亡的早期关注后来成为他艺术创作的重要主题。在菲格拉斯的圣费尔南多学院学习期间，达利开始接触现代艺术，并展现出对细节的极致关注和对怪诞事物的迷恋。
points.descriptionEn: Salvador Dalí was born in Figueres, a town in Catalonia, Spain. His birthplace would later become the location of his most significant work, the Dalí Theatre-Museum. Dalí's childhood was marked by strict Catholic education and the discovery of his extraordinary artistic talent. The early death of his older brother had a profound impact on him, and this preoccupation with death became a recurring theme in his later artwork. During his studies at the Marist Brothers' school in Figueres, Dalí began to encounter modern art and developed his characteristic attention to detail and fascination with the bizarre.

points.title: 美术学院求学
points.description: 1922年，达利进入马德里圣费尔南多皇家美术学院学习。在这里，他接触到了前卫艺术运动，包括达达主义和未来主义，同时深入研究文艺复兴大师的作品。达利展现出非凡的绘画技巧，但他的行为和观点常常引起争议。他与诗人费德里科·加西亚·洛尔卡和电影导演路易斯·布努埃尔建立了深厚的友谊，这些关系对他的艺术发展产生了重要影响。1926年，因拒绝考试和声称教师们没有资格评判他的才华，达利被学院开除。
points.descriptionEn: In 1922, Dalí enrolled at the Royal Academy of Fine Arts of San Fernando in Madrid. Here, he was exposed to avant-garde art movements including Dadaism and Futurism, while also studying the works of Renaissance masters. Dalí demonstrated exceptional painting skills but often caused controversy with his behavior and views. He formed deep friendships with poet Federico García Lorca and filmmaker Luis Buñuel, relationships that would significantly influence his artistic development. In 1926, Dalí was expelled from the academy for refusing to take an exam and claiming the professors were not qualified to judge his talent.

points.title: 超现实主义时期
points.description: 1926年，达利首次前往巴黎，1929年他决定移居巴黎。在巴黎，达利遇到了超现实主义运动的领袖安德烈·布勒东，并正式加入这一艺术运动。他发展出自己独特的'偏执批判法'创作技巧，通过系统性地探索偏执狂的联想过程来激发创作灵感。在巴黎期间，达利创作了《记忆的永恒》等标志性作品，这些作品以荒诞的梦境般的意象和精湛的写实技巧闻名。同时，他与布努埃尔合作创作了超现实主义电影《安达卢西亚之犬》，这部作品成为电影史上的经典之作。
points.descriptionEn: In 1926, Dalí made his first trip to Paris, and in 1929 he decided to move there permanently. In Paris, he met André Breton, the leader of the Surrealist movement, and officially joined this artistic movement. Dalí developed his unique 'paranoiac-critical method' of creating art, systematically exploring the associations of paranoid thought to inspire his work. During his Paris years, Dalí created iconic works like 'The Persistence of Memory,' known for their dreamlike, bizarre imagery and masterful technical execution. He also collaborated with Buñuel on the surrealist film 'Un Chien Andalou,' which became a classic in film history.

points.title: 加泰罗尼亚创作
points.description: 1929年，达利在卡达克斯遇见了他未来的妻子和缪斯加拉·埃利扎别特·('加拉')·迪亚尼·库诺娃。加拉对达利的艺术生涯产生了决定性影响，成为他最重要的模特和灵感来源。在卡达克斯，达利创作了《伟大的自慰者》、《龙虾电话》等代表作，进一步发展了他的超现实主义风格。这段时期也是达利与超现实主义团体关系紧张的时期，他的政治立场和商业成功引起了布勒东等人的不满。1936年，达利在伦敦举办首次个人展览，并参与国际超现实主义展览，进一步确立了他的国际声誉。
points.descriptionEn: In 1929, Dalí met his future wife and muse, Elena Diakonova ('Gala'), in Cadaqués. Gala would have a decisive impact on Dalí's artistic career, becoming his most important model and source of inspiration. In Cadaqués, Dalí created masterpieces like 'The Great Masturbator' and 'Lobster Telephone,' further developing his surrealist style. This period was also marked by tensions with the Surrealist group, as Dalí's political views and commercial success displeased Breton and others. In 1936, Dalí held his first solo exhibition in London and participated in the International Surrealist Exhibition, further establishing his international reputation.

points.title: 流亡与商业成功
points.description: 随着西班牙内战和第二次世界大战的爆发，达利与加拉于1940年移居美国，在纽约和加利福尼亚生活。在美国期间，达利的艺术风格发生了变化，他开始探索宗教和科学主题，创作了《圣约翰的十字架》等作品。达利在美国获得了巨大的商业成功，他与华特·迪士尼合作创作动画短片《 Destino》，与阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克合作电影《爱德华大夫》的梦境场景设计。这段时期，达利出版了自传《达利的秘密生活》，进一步巩固了他的公众形象。1948年，达利决定返回欧洲，但继续与保持与美国艺术界的联系。
points.descriptionEn: With the outbreak of the Spanish Civil War and World War II, Dalí and Gala moved to the United States in 1940, living in New York and California. During his American years, Dalí's artistic style evolved as he began exploring religious and scientific themes, creating works like 'The Cross of St. John.' Dalí achieved significant commercial success in America, collaborating with Walt Disney on the animated short 'Destino' and with Alfred Hitchcock on the dream sequence for 'Spellbound.' During this period, Dalí published his autobiography 'The Secret Life of Salvador Dalí,' further solidifying his public persona. In 1948, Dalí decided to return to Europe but maintained connections with the American art world.

points.title: 晚年与艺术遗产
points.description: 1948年后，达利回到西班牙菲格拉斯，并在加拉的陪伴下度过了余生。这一时期，达利创作了《基督的圣体》、《加拉的基督》等宗教主题作品，同时继续探索科学和数学概念。1974年，达利剧院博物馆在他的家乡菲格拉斯开幕，这座建筑本身就是他的杰作。晚年达利成为国际艺术界的传奇人物，他的作品被全球各大博物馆收藏。然而，他的晚年也受到争议，一些人批评他的商业化和自我推销行为。1982年加拉去世后，达利的健康状况急剧恶化，1989年在菲格拉斯逝世，被安葬在达利剧院博物馆的地下室。
points.descriptionEn: After 1948, Dalí returned to his hometown of Figueres, Spain, where he spent the rest of his life in the company of Gala. During this period, Dalí created religious-themed works like 'Corpus Hypercubus' and 'The Christ of St. John of the Cross,' while continuing to explore scientific and mathematical concepts. In 1974, the Dalí Theatre-Museum opened in his hometown of Figueres, with the building itself being one of his masterpieces. In his later years, Dalí became a legendary figure in the international art world, with his works collected by major museums globally. However, his later years were also marked by controversy, with some critics accusing him of commercialization and self-promotion. After Gala's death in 1982, Dalí's health deteriorated rapidly, and he died in Figueres in 1989, buried in the crypt of the Dalí Theatre-Museum.

appraisal.zh: 达利通常被定位为20世纪最具创新精神的艺术家之一，也是自我塑造的大师：他以精湛技巧与大胆想象挑战传统艺术边界，开创“偏执批判法”，对梦境、潜意识与偏执的探索开辟了艺术心理学的新领域，其跨媒介实践影响了波普艺术与观念艺术，达利剧院博物馆体现了他对艺术与空间融合的前瞻思考，其形象在流行文化中与怪诞、奢华和天才紧密相连。也有研究者指出，他后期作品趋于自我重复与哗众取宠，与佛朗哥政权的暧昧关系被视为政治投机，对女性形象的物化及对加拉的依赖折射出当时的性别权力结构，其超现实主义后期亦被指失去对社会现实的批判性。
appraisal.en: Dalí is usually defined as one of the most innovative artists of the 20th century and a master of self-invention: with masterful technique and bold imagination he challenged traditional artistic boundaries, pioneered the paranoiac-critical method, opened new territory in art psychology through his exploration of dreams, the unconscious and paranoia, and his cross-media practice influenced Pop and Conceptual Art; the Dalí Theatre-Museum reflects his forward-thinking fusion of art and space, and his popular image is bound up with the bizarre, the luxurious and genius. Yet some researchers note that his later works became self-repetitive and sensationalist, that his ambiguous ties to Franco's regime look like political opportunism, and that his objectification of women and dependence on Gala reflect the gender power structures of the time; his later Surrealism, they argue, lost its critical engagement with social reality.

supporter.zh: 达利被视为20世纪最具创新精神的艺术家之一，他将超现实主义推向了新的高度。他的作品以精湛的技巧和大胆的想象力挑战了传统艺术边界，开创了'偏执批判法'这一独特的创作方法。达利对梦境、潜意识和偏执狂的探索，为艺术心理学开辟了新领域。他不仅是一位画家，还是电影、雕塑、摄影和时尚等多领域的先驱，其跨媒介实践影响了后来的波普艺术和观念艺术。达利剧院博物馆的建立也体现了他对艺术与空间融合的前瞻性思考。
supporter.en: Dalí is regarded as one of the most innovative artists of the 20th century, pushing Surrealism to new heights. His works challenged traditional artistic boundaries with masterful technique and bold imagination, pioneering the 'paranoiac-critical method' of creation. Dalí's exploration of dreams, the unconscious, and paranoia opened new territories in art psychology. Beyond painting, he was a pioneer in film, sculpture, photography, and fashion, with his cross-media practices influencing later Pop Art and Conceptual Art. The establishment of the Dalí Theatre-Museum demonstrates his forward-thinking approach to the fusion of art and space.

critic.zh: 批评者认为达利过于注重自我营销和商业成功，削弱了艺术创作的纯粹性。他的后期作品被指责缺乏早期作品的创新性和深度，沦为自我重复和哗众取宠。达利与弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥政权的暧昧关系也引发争议，被批评为政治投机主义。此外，他对女性形象的物化处理，尤其是对加拉的依赖和控制，反映了当时性别权力结构的问题。一些艺术评论家认为达利的超现实主义后期变得肤浅，失去了对社会现实的批判性思考。
critic.en: Critics argue that Dalí's excessive focus on self-promotion and commercial success undermined the purity of his artistic creation. His later works are accused of lacking the innovation and depth of his earlier pieces, becoming self-repetitive and sensationalist. Dalí's ambiguous relationship with Francisco Franco's regime has also sparked controversy, criticized as political opportunism. Additionally, his objectification of women, particularly his dependence on and control over Gala, reflects problematic gender power dynamics of the time. Some art critics contend that Dalí's Surrealism became superficial in his later years, losing its critical engagement with social reality.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，达利被定义为一位复杂而矛盾的文化符号，既是艺术革新者也是自我塑造的大师。他的超现实主义作品已成为西方文化的重要标志，《记忆的永恒》等图像被广泛引用和模仿。达利对艺术商业化的探索预见了后来的艺术市场发展，他的自我营销策略成为艺术家品牌建设的早期范例。在流行文化中，达利形象与怪诞、奢华和天才等特质紧密相连，成为创意灵感的源泉。他的遗产超越了艺术领域，影响了时尚、设计和广告等多个行业，体现了艺术与商业、个人表达与大众文化的复杂交织。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Dalí is defined as a complex and contradictory cultural symbol, both an artistic innovator and a master of self-invention. His surrealist works have become important markers of Western culture, with images like 'The Persistence of Memory' widely referenced and imitated. Dalí's exploration of art commercialization anticipated later developments in the art market, and his self-promotion strategies became early examples of artist branding. In popular culture, Dalí's image is closely associated with the bizarre, luxurious, and genius, serving as a source of creative inspiration. His legacy extends beyond art, influencing fashion, design, and advertising, reflecting the complex interplay between art and commerce, personal expression and popular culture.

self.zh: 每一分钟都是一种疯狂，疯狂到足以改变历史。
self.en: Every minute is a kind of frenzy, a frenzy that is enough to change history.
